in_arabic.name: قمرونیسا
in_arabic.meaning: قمرونیسا يعني القمر في ليلة الظلام

in_urdu.name: قمرونیسا
in_urdu.meaning: قمرونیسا کا مطلب ہے چاند کی روشنی
in_urdu.long_meaning: قمرونیسا نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ قمر اور نيسا سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے چاند کی روشنی یا چاند کی شان۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ خوبصورتی اور الہی نور کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.long_meaning: क़मरोनीसा नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है चंद्रमा की रोशनी। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इसे सुंदरता और दिव्य प्रकाश का प्रतीक माना जाता है

in_english.name: Qamarunnisa
in_english.meaning: Qamarunnisa means the moon in the darkness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Qamarunnisa is derived from the Arabic words 'qamar' (moon) and 'nisa' (light or brightness). It signifies the beauty and radiance of the moon, symbolizing illumination in darkness. Historically, this name has been popular in Islamic cultures for its spiritual significance and poetic beauty. It reflects attributes of serenity, elegance, and inner light

data.cultural_impact: The name "Qamarunnisa" is derived from the Arabic words "Qamar" meaning moon and "un-nisa" meaning woman. In Islamic culture, the moon is considered a symbol of divine guidance, wisdom, and beauty. Naming a girl after the moon, "Qamarunnisa," carries the symbolic significance of bestowing upon her the qualities of wisdom, grace, and guidance.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the moon represents the Divine Light of Allah that illuminates the darkest corners of the soul. As the name "Qamarunnisa," signifies a woman who embodies this light, she is expected to carry and radiate the qualities of kindness, compassion, and knowledge in her actions and interactions with others. The name is a reminder for her to seek the guidance of Allah and illuminate the path for those around her just as the moon reflects the light of the sun and guides us during the night.
